_comment: Contributors and third-party material. Further entries welcome as a file of their own in credits.d/<area>.json (same format: {"entries": [...]}). The texts are English; the app translates use, kind, license and authors through the catalog (diag.CREDIT_TEXTS).

entries.name: Melodee
entries.use: firmware, web editor, installer and manual that the app embeds

entries.name: Felucca
entries.use: basis of Melodee, Skiff, SLOOP and JIANT FM; sampleio.py (vendor) comes from there

entries.name: JIANT FM
entries.use: Felucca fork; its unmodified firmware code runs in the studio twin

entries.name: KARMA
entries.use: SLOOP fork; its unmodified firmware code runs in the studio twin, with the parts it ports (Mutable Instruments' Plaits, Elements and Clouds by Emilie Gillet, MIT; the LXR-02 drum voices by Erica Synths, GPL-3.0)

entries.name: M-VAVE FM1 Open
entries.use: official open firmware, simulator sources, update tools

entries.name: Lucide Icons
entries.use: icons in the app's design (fm1companion/icons/lucide, licence in icons/LICENSE.lucide)

entries.name: mido, python-rtmidi, NumPy
entries.authors: Ole Martin Bjørndalen et al.; Christopher Arndt et al.; NumPy Developers
